# Skills index

This directory holds reusable operational knowledge and task-oriented guidance for future AI sessions and contributors.

## Scope

- build and validation workflows
- content conventions for docs changes
- architecture-oriented repository patterns
- reusable task and prompt templates

## Organization

- `architecture/`: system-level and design guidance
- `build/`: commands and validation workflow
- `browser-testing/`: inspecting rendered pages with `playwright-core` (includes a reusable example script)
- `content/`: writing and documentation conventions
- `templates/`: task/document starter templates

## Maintenance

Add a new category only when it represents a distinct operational concern, and keep this index updated when the category list changes.
